description: Project capital growth from reinvesting perpetual futures funding income (compounding carry). Use when user asks "how much will I make compounding 0.01% funding for 90 days?" or "what's my APY on this carry position?". Funding received is split by reinvestPct (the rest is withdrawn and still counts as earned); funding paid comes out of capital in full, and the capital never goes below 0. Returns: finalCapital, totalWithdrawn, endValue, totalEarned, totalEarnedPct, annualizedAPY, dailyEarnings, snapshots.

durationDays.description: Number of days to project, up to 3650

fundingRatePct.description: Funding rate per interval as percentage, e.g. 0.01 for 0.01%

intervalHours.description: Hours between funding payments, the period fundingRatePct covers, a whole number of hours that divides 24. Default 8; 1 on Hyperliquid, dYdX, Kraken and Backpack (per-hour rates); 4 or 2 on some symbols.

reinvestPct.description: Percentage of funding received that is reinvested each interval, 0-100 (the rest is withdrawn and counts as earned; funding paid always comes out of capital). 100 = full compounding. Default 100.

name: workflow.run_compound_funding
title: Compound Funding
